name: Gopi Haveli
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gopi Haveli in Seefeld in Tirol**

Discover the vibrant flavors of India in the heart of the Alps! At **Gopi Haveli**, we invite you to experience authentic Indian cuisine in a cozy, warm atmosphere. Whether you're craving a spicy **Butter Chicken**, a fragrant **Masala Dosa**, or a creamy **Mango Lassi**, our menu offers a delightful journey through India’s rich culinary traditions.

Located in the picturesque village of **Seefeld in Tirol**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, our restaurant is the perfect spot to unwind after a day of skiing, hiking, or exploring the stunning **Tirol** landscapes. Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert—though it’s Austrian, we’ve given it an Indian twist!

Come taste the world at **Gopi Haveli**—where every bite tells a story. **Namaste!**
